name: aisztens
description: AIsztens monorepo: NestJS+Fastify API, React public site, React admin SPA

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shared,api,web,admin -c yellow,blue,green,magenta "pnpm --filter @callback/shared dev" "pnpm --filter @callback/api start:dev" "pnpm --filter @callback/web dev" "pnpm --filter @callback/admin dev"
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @callback/shared test && pnpm --filter @callback/api-client test && pnpm --filter @callback/ui test && pnpm --filter @callback/admin test && pnpm --filter @callback/api test
scripts.sonar:coverage: pnpm --filter @callback/shared test:cov && pnpm --filter @callback/api-client test:cov && pnpm --filter @callback/ui test:cov && pnpm --filter @callback/admin test:cov && pnpm --filter @callback/api test:cov && node scripts/sonar/lcov-merge.mjs
